title: Algebra Play: Tricks and Puzzles
summary: Think-of-a-number tricks, number pyramids and calendar puzzles, all explained with algebra.

ib.note: Proving conjectures algebraically builds MYP Criteria B and C

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 6: Algebra Play

objectives: I can use algebra to explain why a number trick works.
I can solve puzzles by setting up expressions.
I can create and prove my own trick.
misconceptions: Testing a few numbers proves a trick always works.
